newsitem.title: RUSSIA: TABLE - Russian July inflation 0.9 pct vs 1.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - Russian July inflation 0.9 pct vs 1.1 pct.

text.p: Russia's monthly consumer price inflation slowed in July to 0.9 percent, the State Statistics Committee said on Tuesday.
RUSSIAN CONSUMER PRICES JULY 97 JUNE 97 JULY 96
Average daily inflation in July slowed to 0.030 percent from 0.036 percent in June, the committee said.

In the first seven months of this year prices rose 9.6 percent. The government has forecast inflation over the whole year of 11.8 percent but on Monday First Deputy Prime Minister Anatoly Chubais said this might be overshot.
